thread:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up: engineering wants to land a breaking change in partner SDK v4 next quarter. Plan: remove legacy `batch` envelope and enforce `X-Redwood-Auth: v2` + stricter content validation. This impacts marketplace connectors, HW adapters, and SI integrations. We need partner coordination.
Ben Chu: Got it. What timeline are they targeting?
Aisha Patel: Targeting code freeze in 21 days, followed by 60-day deprecation. We may offer a short compatibility path for Dedicated/private installs.
Priya Kapoor: From GTM: partners expect at least 8 weeks notice. We should prepare a partner comms kit (email, FAQ, migration guide, banner copy) and coordinate a marketplace update. I can draft the kit if we give me the spec.
Marco Silva: HW partners: firmware release cadence is monthly but QA windows vary. A hard 60-day window without a shim will be rough. Can we provide a compatibility adapter for our on-prem gateway?
Ben Chu: Devs propose a feature-flagged shim that replays old `batch` semantics for ~45 days after freeze. We'll also add `--compat` telemetry in the SDK and a detection script for vendor gateways.
Dana Li: I'll book partner syncs. Proposed agenda: what changes, impact matrix, migration steps, rollback plan, and available support (engineer office hours, migration bounty). Need a one-pager and a checklist to share.
Emma Torres: SIs will want tests + upstream sample apps. Can we expose a failing-test harness that flags deprecated envelope usage? We can run compatibility tests with 2 SIs if we have the shim and harness in ~6 business days.
Ben Chu: Plan for SDK flags: `--compat=log|shim|enforce` and a telemetry opt-in. Example quick-check: `curl -X POST $URL -H "X-Redwood-Auth: v1" -d '{}' -I` should return a deprecation header in responses. We'll publish the header spec to the repo within 5 business days.
Aisha Patel: decisions: 1) Offer a 45-day feature-flagged shim for Dedicated/on-prem. 2) Publish spec + migration guide within 7 days. 3) GTM to prepare partner comms and marketplace assets (Priya). 4) Ops to add validation rules for v2 header in staging.
Marco Silva: If shim build is ready in 7 days we'll run it through our gateway fleet. If we find breaking firmware dependencies we'll need to escalate.
Priya Kapoor: I'll prepare draft email + marketplace banner and include an opt-in migration webinar invite. Also suggest a shared status page link for partners to track adoption.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing updated draft saved at /mkplace/drafts/sdk-v4-compat.
Ben Chu: also adding a migration snippet for adapters:
```
// old envelope
{"batch": [{"input":"..."}], "model":"rwd-lite"}
// new shape
{"requests": [{"input":"..."}], "model":"rwd-lite"}
// header required
X-Redwood-Auth: v2
```
Dana Li: will circulate partner meeting invites once the one-pager is ready. Scheduling 2 sessions to cover APAC and NA/EU partners.
Emma Torres: confirming SI test runs if we have the harness by next Friday. Please add contact list for SI leads and escalation path.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the spec lands and the shim build is validated. Flag any blockers in this thread. :white_check_mark:
